summary: At process switch `pre_handoff_regression` value `touched_suites`, the selection and the run keep every earlier story's suite. `regression-selection` and `regression-run` refuse when the Delivery Review record of an earlier Delivery at `review` or `awaiting_merge` cannot be read, as they refuse an unreadable Delivery or Item record, because that record alone proves the merge: such a Delivery no longer counts as unmerged with its suites left out. An earlier story's targets come from the Test Plan revision its Item integrated, the one whose digest the Item records as `test_plan_source_hash`: the candidate's own Test Plan while it is that revision, else that revision read from the candidate's Git history, and the newest such revision when the candidate holds a later integration of the same story, of a merged Delivery or of the current one. A backlog revision made for a later Delivery therefore neither adds targets no test implements yet nor drops targets whose tests still guard the delivered behaviour, and the selection names each earlier story's `test_plan_source_hash` and `test_plan_commit`. It refuses only when neither the candidate nor its history holds that revision, or when the Item records none. As in QA's diagnostic run, a `regression-run` whose command changes the selection it receives or `scratch/pre-handoff-selection.json` records `selection_intact` false and is not intact, so `freeze` refuses it with `DELIVERY_PRE_HANDOFF_MISSING` and says the run changed the selection it ran.
